project: GenX Leadership Academy Bounded Dual-Stream RAG

requirements_traceability.description: Read supplied mock transcript dataset and support n8n item wrappers
requirements_traceability.node: Read Transcripts File & Parse Transcripts Array
requirements_traceability.implementation: Reads /data/mock_transcripts.json via readWriteFile, parses UTF-8 JSON buffer without BOM, maps each session to an n8n item wrapper { json: session }.

requirements_traceability.description: Turn sampling: first 40 and last 20 turns for long transcripts (>60 turns); avoid duplicate sampling for <= 60 turns
requirements_traceability.implementation: Checks transcript.length. If > 60, concatenates slice(0, 40) and slice(-20); otherwise preserves slice().

requirements_traceability.description: Classify meetings using structured JSON (meeting_type, confidence_score, summary)
requirements_traceability.implementation: Ollama Classifier prompts llama3.2:1b with 4 rules; Validate Classification parses JSON, clamps score 0.0-1.0, and sets is_accepted.

requirements_traceability.description: Accept only Client Coaching with confidence >= 0.80
requirements_traceability.implementation: If node evaluates is_accepted === true, requiring meeting_type === 'Client Coaching' AND confidence_score >= 0.80.

requirements_traceability.description: Archive Internal Operations, Sales Discovery, Other, and low-confidence meetings into rejected_meetings without embeddings
requirements_traceability.node: Format Rejected Record & Transactional Archive Rejected
requirements_traceability.implementation: Firewall Gate false branch routes directly to archive_rejected_meeting PL/pgSQL function. Zero embeddings generated.

requirements_traceability.description: Extract conceptual coaching frameworks preserving discussion meaning and source timestamps
requirements_traceability.node: Ollama Framework Extractor & Format Dual-Stream Chunks
requirements_traceability.implementation: Prompts llama3.2:1b for frameworks (name, definition, mechanism, application, timestamps). Formats framework chunk with metadata.

requirements_traceability.description: Voice stream: store Dr. Sara Hegy spoken dialogue verbatim, 400-700 chars where possible, combine adjacent coach turns, never include client speech
requirements_traceability.implementation: Filters turns strictly on speaker === 'Dr. Sara Hegy'. Client speech excluded. Non-adjacent turns preserved individually. Chunks: 280, 402, 154 chars (SES-101) and 261, 393, 132 chars (SES-102).

requirements_traceability.description: Embed both streams separately and store in knowledge_vault with 1024-d vectors
requirements_traceability.node: Ollama Chunk Embedder & Validate & Assemble Chunks & Atomic Vault Replacement Function
requirements_traceability.implementation: bge-m3 embeds all 4 chunks sequentially. Validate node verifies 1024 numeric dimensions, speaker identity, and calls ingest_session_vault exactly once.

requirements_traceability.description: Strict session isolation: no cross-session data leakage and no lost chunks
requirements_traceability.node: Process Sessions Sequentially & Validate & Assemble Chunks
requirements_traceability.implementation: Process Sessions Sequentially isolates each session batch. Chunks and embeddings are matched 1-to-1 without cross-run .all() lookups.

requirements_traceability.description: Sequential processing and low memory footprint suitable for 8 GB RAM
requirements_traceability.implementation: Sequential item execution across Ollama HTTP requests; batchSize 1 on sessions; single-threaded inference on CPU.
